import httpx

def gen():
    yield b"--b\r\n\r\nx\r\n--b--\r\n"

r = httpx.Response(200, headers={"content-type": "multipart/mixed; boundary=b"}, content=gen())
assert not hasattr(r, "_content")
assert [p.content for p in r.iter_multipart()] == [b"x"]
try:
    r.iter_multipart()
except httpx.StreamConsumed:
    print("generator content is streaming, consumed once ok")

# list/tuple content is in-memory and repeatable
r = httpx.Response(200, headers={"content-type": "multipart/mixed; boundary=b"}, content=[b"--b\r\n\r\nx\r\n--b--\r\n"])
assert hasattr(r, "_content")
assert [p.content for p in r.iter_multipart()] == [b"x"]
assert [p.content for p in r.iter_multipart()] == [b"x"]
print("list content in-memory repeatable ok")
EOF
